blocks.text:
After breakfast, set off on a circuit tour of Bariloche. The road follows Avenida Bustillo along Lake Nahuel Huapi. At around kilometre 8 lies Playa Bonita, with views of Huemul Island. The route then passes through different natural landscapes to the foot of Cerro Campanario.

A chairlift takes you to around 1,500 m above sea level. At the top there is a pastry shop, with a terrace above it offering a broad panorama of the surrounding area. From here you can see Lakes Nahuel Huapi and Perito Moreno, Clover Lagoon, the Llao Llao and San Pedro peninsulas, Victoria Island, the Otto, López, Goye and Catedral mountains, and San Carlos de Bariloche.

The road continues through Llao Llao. Here you will find San Eduardo Chapel, the Llao Llao Hotel, opened in 1939 and designed by architect Alejandro Bustillo, and Puerto Pañuelo on the lakeshore.

After circling the lake, the route crosses a bridge over the Angostura River, which connects Lakes Moreno and Nahuel Huapi. It then passes Bahía López at the foot of the mountain of the same name and reaches the Panoramic Point at an altitude of 945 m, overlooking Lake Moreno and the Llao Llao peninsula.

Continuing along the shore of Lake Moreno, the route reaches the bridge across the lake, then follows El Trébol back to the main road and returns to Bariloche. The afternoon is free. Accommodation.
